capabilities: define words and phrases in dedicated definition files
hover or run a command to preview a definition inside a note
jump from an underlined term to its definition file
scope which definition files a note uses via def-context properties
discover definition files by folder or by tag
extras: README warns that tag-based definition file discovery scans every file in the vault and may hurt performance on large vaults.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up custom definitions of words or phrases while reading or writing a note.
summary: Personal dictionary plugin that stores definitions in vault notes and shows hover previews of defined terms inside your notes.
